results.change_intent: Refactor SocketAddress to remove fixed statements and use CsWin32 SOCKADDR types directly.
results.summary: Introduces a bug in GetPort() where ports >= 32768 (including ephemeral ports) are returned as negative numbers due to short sign extension.

issues.comment: IPAddress.NetworkToHostOrder((short)...) returns a signed 16-bit short. When the port number is in the range 32768-65535 (such as ephemeral/dynamic client ports), the short value is negative, and converting it to int sign-extends it into a negative integer.
issues.suggestion: Cast the result of NetworkToHostOrder to ushort before returning, or use BinaryPrimitives.ReverseEndianness(_sockaddr.sin_port).

issues.comment: IPAddress.NetworkToHostOrder((short)...) returns a signed 16-bit short. When the IPv6 port number is in the range 32768-65535, returning it as int sign-extends the negative short value into a negative integer.
issues.suggestion: Cast the result of NetworkToHostOrder to ushort before returning, or use BinaryPrimitives.ReverseEndianness(_sockaddr.sin6_port).
